stem.text: A bicycle pedal is connected to a pivot by a metal bar, as shown.

stem.alt: Bicycle pedal drawn as a horizontal bar, joined by a metal bar to a pivot at its lower left end. A downward arrow labelled force 60 N acts on the pedal. Dimensions of 20 cm along the bar, 16 cm horizontally and 12 cm vertically are marked.

stem.text: The force on the pedal is $60\,\text{N}$ downwards.
What is the moment of this force about the pivot?
